services.name: Log Cabin
services.desc: Our Deluxe Cabins sleep 6 with a queen bed, queen futon, twin bunk, fully equipped kitchen, bathroom with shower and tub, and AC/heat. Rustic Cabins sleep 4 with a double bed, two bunk beds, microwave, small refrigerator, and heat/AC - perfect for families who want a roof overhead while staying close to nature.

services.name: RV Rentals
services.desc: Our Easy Get-A-Way Tent Package at Horton's is perfect for families who want to camp without the setup. We provide a six-person tent with air mattresses and a fire pit with grill - you supply the s'mores. Sleeping bags are available for purchase

services.name: View Campsites
services.desc: Choose from Preferred, Premium, or Standard W/E/S full-hookup sites with 30 or 50-amp electric, fire ring, and picnic table. Pull-through and back-in options are available, and many sites are pet friendly. Seasonal camping is also available for families who want to make Eagles Peak their home away from home all season
